results.headline: Bekaert - Trading update for the nine months ...
results.key_quote: Bekaert delivered strong growth in the third quarter, with like-for-like sales increasing across all divisions and geographies... The Group now expects full-year 2026 sales to be above the 2025 level, compared with previous guidance for sales to be similar to 2025.
results.summary: Bekaert reported strong Q3 2026 performance with like-for-like sales up 8% and consolidated sales up 12% versus Q3 2025. For the nine-month period, like-for-like sales increased 3% year-on-year. Crucially, the company upgraded its full-year 2026 sales guidance from 'similar to 2025' to 'above the 2025 level', demonstrating better-than-expected performance. This guidance upgrade indicates results are tracking ahead of previous expectations. However, underlying EBIT margin expectations remain unchanged at slightly below 2025 levels, which provides a slight hedge on profitability. The strong broad-based volume growth across all divisions and successful cost pass-through demonstrate operational execution ahead of market conditions.
metrics_ahead: Full-year 2026 sales guidance upgraded to above 2025 level
Volume growth across all divisions and geographies

results.headline: Unaudited interim results for the three-and n...
results.key_quote: Serabi's costs are normalizing in comparison to Q2-2026 given the extraordinary costs during the previous quarter. Total cash cost and AISC on a year-to-date basis are $2,114/oz and $2,716/oz, respectively.
results.summary: Serabi Gold reported nine-month 2026 results with production of 34,057 ounces, slightly ahead of the prior year (32,634 ounces). EBITDA, profit, and earnings per share all improved versus the corresponding 2025 period. However, the company did not explicitly state these results were ahead of market or analyst expectations. The revised FY2026 production guidance of 39,000-40,000 ounces appears consistent with prior guidance trajectory. While operational cash flow improved and the balance sheet remains strong, there is no stated comparison to expectations. The cost increases (cash cost and AISC) reflect higher gold prices received, with the company noting costs are normalizing. No upgrade or downgrade of guidance is announced; the revision is operationally driven by the GUIA licence tonnage limit.

results.headline: Results of Annual General Meeting
results.key_quote: The Company advises that all motions put to the meeting were decided on a show of hands, with all resolutions carried.
results.summary: This is an RNS announcement reporting the results of the Annual General Meeting held on 26 November 2026. All resolutions were carried on a show of hands with no poll called. The announcement contains procedural information about shareholder voting outcomes but does not include any financial results, operational performance metrics, or comparisons to expectations.

results.headline: Auction Results: Higher-Quality Emeralds
results.key_quote: Kagem's 56th emerald auction has delivered an excellent result, bringing our 2026 emerald auction revenue to USD 91.7 million, the third-highest calendar-year total since our first auction in 2009. It is particularly pleasing to close the year with such a robust response to our higher-quality offering in Bangkok.
results.summary: Gemfields reports auction results for higher-quality emeralds with USD 35.3 million in revenues and 100% sell-through rate. The company characterizes this as an 'excellent result' and 'robust response', noting 2026 emerald auction revenue of USD 91.7 million is the third-highest calendar-year total since 2009. The 100% sell-through rate and strong pricing (USD 160.47/carat) are presented positively, with management expressing particular satisfaction with closing the year strongly. No explicit pre-auction expectations or guidance are provided in the announcement.
metrics_ahead: 2026 total emerald auction revenue USD 91.7 million is third-highest calendar-year total since 2009

results.headline: AGM Statement
results.key_quote: trading in FY27 has started positively, in line with the guidance provided at the time of the Group's Final Results in September
results.summary: Craneware reports that FY27 trading has started positively and is in line with guidance provided at Final Results in September. The company confirms it expects to exit FY27 in line with EBITDA guidance and return to a 30% EBITDA margin in FY28. Results are explicitly stated as matching expectations, not exceeding them. Trading performance is described as 'in line with' previous guidance rather than ahead of or beating market expectations.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Narf has made good progress during the first half of the financial year, reporting a 28% increase in revenue and a 25% reduction in losses compared with the corresponding period last year.
results.summary: NARF reported revenue growth of 28% to $2.63m and a 25% reduction in losses to $418,279 for HY2026. The company provided FY2027 revenue guidance of approximately $4.1m based on government contracts and ongoing commercial development. No explicit comparison to market, analyst, or board expectations was stated. The results show operational improvements but are presented as performance versus prior year comparisons rather than versus external expectations. The company notes commercial engagements are progressing but taking longer than anticipated, suggesting some shortfall against internal timeline expectations.

results.headline: Results of 2026 Realisation Share Offer
results.key_quote: The Company is pleased to confirm the results of the realisation share offer made to ordinary shareholders
results.summary: This announcement reports the results of a 2026 Realisation Share Offer, confirming that 2,495,250 ordinary shares (4.4967% of issued shares) have been elected for redesignation as 2026 Realisation Shares. The shares have been admitted to trading on the LSE Specialist Fund Segment. No performance metrics, financial results, or comparison to expectations are provided in this announcement.

results.headline: AGM Statement and Trading Update
results.key_quote: the Directors believe that the Company remains on track to deliver profits in line with market expectations for FY27
results.summary: Transense reported revenue growth of 10% year-on-year in the first four months of FY27, with gross margins consistent at >85%. All three business segments showed growth (Bridgestone iTrack +7%, SAWsense +17%, Translogik +8%). AEBITDA was at similar levels to prior year with a small loss after interest, depreciation and amortisation. The company explicitly states it is 'on track to deliver profits in line with market expectations for FY27', which is an IN_LINE classification. While new business wins (Continental contract) and pipeline opportunities are noted as progressing well and expected to contribute in H2, the guidance is explicitly matched to market expectations rather than positioned as ahead of them.
metrics_ahead: Total group revenue growth of 10% year-on-year
Cash generative operations with improved cash balance

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Consequently, the Board now expects profit before tax and exceptionals for the year to be approximately £4.8m, which is below previous market expectations*. *Company calculated analyst consensus is PBT of £6.05m for 2026
results.summary: Churchill China reports full-year 2026 results materially below market expectations. Profit before tax and exceptionals expected at approximately £4.8m versus analyst consensus of £6.05m. Hospitality revenue expected ~2% below 2025, and total Group revenue ~3.8% below prior year due to subdued European demand, geopolitical uncertainty, and lower than expected sales volumes in October and November. While some positive elements noted (UK strong performance, Germany positive, Germany and US outperforming), the overall financial outcome and revenue guidance represent a significant shortfall from expectations.
metrics_ahead: UK business delivered strong sales performance

results.headline: Unaudited Results for Period Ended 30 Sept 2026
results.key_quote: At the date of this report, further funding is required within the very near term to allow the Group and Company to realise its assets and discharge its liabilities including managing its creditor position in the normal course of business.
results.summary: Beowulf Mining announced unaudited results for the nine months ended 30 September 2026. The announcement contains no comparison of financial results to expectations, analyst forecasts, board guidance, or market expectations. Instead, it focuses on corporate developments including a proposed strategic investment from Bacchus Capital (£3.7 million as part of £4.3 million financing) which faced regulatory delays in Sweden. The company disclosed it urgently requires additional near-term financing with no certainty of securing funds on the appropriate timeframe. No performance metrics, revenue, profit, or operational KPIs are compared against any stated expectations.

results.headline: 3rd Quarter Results
results.key_quote: Receipts for the first nine months of the year totalled £95.1 million (18.7% of opening NAV), which is already ahead of the £80.1 million received during the whole of 2025.
results.summary: The Company reported NAV total return of +1.0% for the quarter and +0.8% for nine months. While nine-month realisations of £95.1 million exceeded full-year 2025 receipts of £80.1 million, this is a comparison to prior-year performance, not stated expectations. Portfolio metrics show strong underlying growth (16-27% revenue/EBITDA growth depending on segment), and exits averaged 3.6x cost with 30% uplift to carrying value. However, the share price declined -3.5% in quarter and -12.5% year-to-date as discount widened sector-wide. The announcement contains no explicit comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance for 2026 results, making this a results report without stated expectations.

results.headline: AGM Statement
results.key_quote: Whilst key project milestones during 2026 have taken longer to deliver than initially anticipated, the Company has further strengthened its commercial capabilities...
results.summary: Quadrise provided an AGM update with project progress on marine, refinery, Valkor, Americas and OCP initiatives. While the company notes that key milestones took longer than initially anticipated (suggesting delays versus prior expectations), the statement focuses on operational progress and pipeline development rather than comparing current results against specific market or analyst expectations. No financial results, profit metrics, or revenue figures are provided for comparison to expectations. The company indicates sufficient cash through September 2027 pending funding, and is pursuing a Strategic Review for commercialisation acceleration. This is a business update without performance metrics or earnings guidance versus expectations.

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: the Board now expects FY26 adjusted operating profit to be within a range of £28-29m... 2026 consensus adjusted operating profit is currently £33.9m
results.summary: Stelrad has significantly lowered its FY26 adjusted operating profit guidance to £28-29m, down from consensus expectations of £33.9m. This represents a material downgrade driven by subdued RMI and new build end-market activity, increased macroeconomic uncertainty in H2, and rising competitive pressures. While the company maintains strong operational metrics (98% on-time in-full rate and market-leading cost position), the lower volumes and profit guidance clearly position results BELOW market expectations.
metrics_ahead: UK On Time In Full rate of 98%
contribution per radiator maintained at strong levels
market share outperformance versus broader market

results.headline: Statement re Satisfaction of Regulatory Conditions
results.key_quote: Gamma and Bidco are pleased to announce that all regulatory Conditions as set out in paragraphs 3(a) to 3(g) of Part A of Part III have now been satisfied.
results.summary: This is an RNS announcement regarding the satisfaction of regulatory conditions for a recommended cash offer by Bradbury Bidco Limited for Gamma Communications. The announcement confirms that all regulatory conditions have been satisfied and provides an updated timetable for the scheme implementation, with the Sanction Hearing scheduled for 14 January 2027 and expected Effective Date of 18 January 2027. This is a corporate transaction announcement and does not contain any financial results, operational performance metrics, or forward guidance that would allow comparison to market or analyst expectations.

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: trading in the Group's core US market has been softer than anticipated during the second half, with conditions becoming more challenging in Q4...these factors have combined to result in lower than anticipated US revenue during H2 and a reduction in the Group's full-year revenue expectations.
results.summary: Power Probe has reported FY26 revenue expectations of $34.5-36.0 million, down significantly from prior year FY25 of $39.4 million. The company explicitly states that H2 trading was 'softer than anticipated' and that there has been a 'reduction in the Group's full-year revenue expectations' due to macroeconomic headwinds, inflationary pressures, and customer inventory rationalisation. While strategic progress on products and manufacturing facilities is noted positively, the core trading performance is below expectations. The company has lowered guidance for FY26 revenue and expects macroeconomic headwinds to persist into FY27.

results.headline: Further re Final Results, Broker & Funding
results.key_quote: profitability was significantly below budget and the same period last year
results.summary: Coral Products has announced a further delay in publishing final results (now expected mid-December 2026 instead of end-November), along with significant operational challenges. The company disclosed that trading in Q1 FY2027 was significantly below budget and prior year performance, despite sales being in line with budget. The CEO has been terminated, trading remains suspended on AIM, and the company is exploring additional funding options. No forward guidance on expected performance versus analyst expectations has been provided in this update.

results.headline: Operational and corporate update
results.key_quote: The Board is reviewing a range of options to put the Company on a more sustainable footing during 2027.
results.summary: Ascent Resources provides an operational and corporate update with no financial results or performance metrics compared to expectations. The update covers settlement discussions regarding Slovenia ICSID tribunal costs, progress on US onshore gas processing plant recommissioning planned for Q1 2027, and efforts to secure funding and explore asset transactions. No guidance, forecasts, or comparisons to market or board expectations are provided.

results.headline: Baillie Gifford European Grwth Trst Annual Results
results.key_quote: the Company's net asset value per share (NAV) total return was +15.2% compared to a total return of +14.5% for the FTSE Europe ex UK Index in sterling terms
results.summary: The Company delivered a full-year NAV total return of +15.2%, modestly ahead of the FTSE Europe ex UK Index benchmark return of +14.5% in sterling terms. Share price total return was +16.7%. Performance was mixed across the year, with a disappointing first half (NAV -9.2% vs benchmark +4.4%) followed by a strong second half after portfolio repositioning (NAV +26.9% vs benchmark +9.6%). The Board expresses increased optimism about the Company's future positioning following management changes and portfolio broadening.
metrics_ahead: Second half NAV return 26.9% vs benchmark 9.6%
Discount to NAV narrowed from 8.6% to 7.5%

results.headline: Crop & production update; share buyback programme
results.key_quote: continued strong crop and production growth during the second half of 2026
results.summary: M.P. Evans reports strong operational performance with crop harvested up 14% year-to-date, CPO output up 13%, and improved oil-extraction rates. The company continues to exceed expectations with robust production despite challenging weather conditions mid-year. Management remains confident in delivering excellent results for the full year. Additional £2 million share buyback allocation reflects confidence in performance.
metrics_ahead: CPO output up 13% versus prior year
improved oil-extraction rates reducing unit costs
strong performance despite extended dry weather

results.headline: Final Results
results.key_quote: profit before tax was £2.4m (2025: £1.7m)...earnings per share was 205.31p (2025: 132.90p)...net assets per share increased 6.0% over the year
results.summary: Cardiff Property delivered results ahead of expectations with profit before tax up 41% to £2.4m, earnings per share up 54% to 205.31p, and net assets per share up 6.0% to £32.35. The group benefited from a £0.4m share of profit from the sale of The Priory property. No formal guidance was provided, but financial metrics showed material improvement year-on-year, supported by firm commercial property market conditions and increased property valuations in the care homes sector.
metrics_ahead: Net assets per share up 6.0% to £32.35
Campmoss joint venture contribution up significantly to £1.06m from £0.38m
